title: Accepted assignment without review metadata
journey: A resident compares two repair services.
objective: Prove that accepted assignments record artifacts and human review.
constraints: Keep the invalid state limited to review metadata.

ai_steps.prompt: Inspect the assignment record and list the evidence that supports acceptance.
Check whether the completion record identifies its artifacts and human reviewer.

deliverables.name: completion-record
deliverables.contents: A completion record tied to artifacts and a human decision.

acceptance: The reviewed artifacts and human decision are explicit.
learning_check: Explain why acceptance must identify its evidence and reviewer.
handoff: Give the accepted record to the next work unit.
